items.title: Clarify the low-risk one-round policy in the canonical decision docs
items.context: Update the central policy wording so annotation compliance / pure typo / wording-only changes are explicitly grouped as low-risk one-round audits without changing the stronger 3-round rule for lifecycle, gate, Authority, or process-fact work.
items.userSees: The policy docs now show the exact phrase "annotation compliance / pure typo / wording-only changes are one-round cases", and the adjacent runbooks point back to that canonical rule.

happy.desc: The updated docs explicitly classify annotation-compliance and pure typo-only changes as low-risk one-round work, and `lattice convergence_check --json` remains green for annotation compliance.

edge.desc: If a doc section still says only wording-only without naming annotation compliance or pure typo, revise the wording rather than changing the audit rule itself.

adversarial.desc: Do not weaken the three-round requirement for lifecycle, gate, Authority, or process-fact changes, and do not claim Authority Server completion.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "annotation-compliance|pure typo|wording-only|one two-host audit round|3 rounds x 2 hosts" docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md docs/requirements/decisions/done-closure-runbook-assistant-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/scope-check-missing-guidance-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The canonical doc now names annotation-compliance / pure typo / wording-only as low-risk one-round cases, so the bucket is not left as a vague wording-only exception.
The docs still keep the 3-round path for lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact work and do not claim Authority Server completion.

items.title: Keep the strong three-round rule intact for high-risk work
items.context: Verify that the updated wording still leaves high-risk lifecycle, gate, Authority, and process-fact changes on the 3-round two-host path and that annotation validation / convergence checks still pass after the doc edits.
items.userSees: The stronger audit rule still says "high-risk lifecycle, gate, Authority, and process-fact changes require the stronger three-round two-host path".

happy.desc: After the doc edits, the relevant policy text still preserves the 3-round rule for high-risk lifecycle / gate / Authority work, and validation checks remain green.

edge.desc: A document-only policy clarification must not introduce new runtime gate behavior or new Authority evidence semantics.

adversarial.desc: The verification transcript must not present the docs-only clarification as production or Authority Server proof.

verificationEvidence.note: The clarification stays docs-only and does not alter runtime gate or Authority evidence semantics.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "production|Authority Server proof|Authority Server completion|local Non-authority" docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The transcript only records docs and rg validation, not production or Authority proof, and the policy text keeps Authority claims separate.
